items.name: Eyvind's Cut Arm-Ring
items.lore: Silver, cut through where an oath was broken. It can never be mended.

items.name: Oathbreaker's Cloak
items.lore: Ragged and black. Deserters of the blood-fellowship wear them so they can find each other.

items.name: Huginfel Hearth-Ring
items.lore: The kind of ring a mother gives a son who came home.

items.name: Blood-Fellowship Torc
items.lore: Taken from a svard of the blodfelag. The inside is stained.

items.name: Haxa's Binding-Cord
items.lore: Plaited from wolf hair and a woman's. Cut now. It still twitches sometimes.

items.name: Wolf-Brother Pelt
items.lore: A sveawolf's grey pelt, freely given.

items.name: Shield-Mate's Ring
items.lore: Huscarls who stand together trade rings. Grettir gave you his.

items.name: Gothi Rune-Belt
items.lore: Carved with the runes for 'man' and 'return'.
